scope: NUERS local application transactional email coverage and implementation review
status: Implemented, verified and activated locally after explicit user approval

controls: Current password required for change
12 characters with letters and numbers, at most 72 bytes
Single-use hashed reset token, 30-minute expiry
Generic recovery response
Trusted configured URL, token kept in URL fragment
Application sessions revoked, MFA preserved
Earlier Google handoff invalidated after password change
Mandatory security category
Registered account recipient rather than a changed profile contact
No password, MFA seed, API key or recovery code in notifications
Deduplicated failed-login and new-browser alerts
Admin SMTP used for real registration codes
10-minute OTP, attempt limits and hashed verification
48-hour invitation, checked again before dispatch
One-day account email verification
NUERS approval is separate from BIR authority

coverage.feature: Customer invoice and receipt PDF copies
controls: Asynchronous response, live delivery-history refresh
Recipient selected by authorized merchant
Tenant and issuer membership rechecked in worker
Same shared invoice preview PDF renderer
Request idempotency and pending-recipient/document deduplication
Financial/source fields unchanged
Authoritative user email only
One reply notification per unread burst
Status changes only, not priority-only edits
Private conversation content and bearer tokens excluded
Allowlisted audit events
No email on ingestion hot path or passive polling
Tenant owner or privileged platform operators only
Digest deduplication
No simulation represented as BIR acknowledgment

delivery_controls.storage: Encrypted recipient, content and token-bearing links in a database outbox
delivery_controls.claiming: Transactional claim with lease token, bounded preparation retries and stale-worker checks
delivery_controls.smtp: TLS and peer verification required, vetted DNS pinning preserved
delivery_controls.payload_retention: Outbox content cleared on terminal or expired processing
delivery_controls.priority: Security ahead of customer copies and workflow/operations
delivery_controls.preferences: Optional workflow, support and operations categories; essential security alerts cannot be disabled

administration.account_controls: Security & Email account menu, Merchant Notifications and Citizen Security

boundaries: No real external email or SMTP test was sent during this work; delivery verification used mocks and synthetic local QA accounts.
No production deployment, DNS authentication change or BIR API transmission was performed.
Inbox delivery, bounce handling, SPF/DKIM/DMARC and provider reputation are not established by code tests.
Anonymous visitor email is unverified, so private support mail is restricted to authenticated accounts.
Customer financial documents are sent only through the explicit merchant copy action; no historical bulk emailing.
Website subscription-plan management has no real charge/renewal event; no invented billing-success or failed-payment email is sent.
Infrastructure outages require external monitoring; an offline application cannot independently email its own outage.

activation.config: NUERS_NOTIFICATION_DISPATCH_ENABLED=true only after explicit outbound rollout approval
activation.scheduler: Minute delivery fallback and hourly reminder reconciliation
activation.approval: User explicitly approved activating NUERS email delivery in this chat.
